text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The other day, Falcon and the others were 
right here...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, keep it up! Let's all sing 
together!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Suzuka-chan! Ready, set, 
go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Songs have the power to convey feelings. 
So as long as you put your heart into 
singing your absolute best, everything 
will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We'll definitely get more participants 
today! Other girls who want to sing their 
feelings of gratitude together with us!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This live will surely be a success. 
Without a doubt...!
The 2nd Live is about to begin!
